answer.reason: The verses give one deed, his killing of a giant's son in battle with the Philistines, which the summary names only as a relation.

clauses.english: slew Saph, one of the sons of the giant, in battle with the Philistines at Gob
clauses.quote: Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant

doubts: 1CH 20:4 tells of Sibbechai slaying Sippai at Gezer, probably the same event under other names, so it is not cited.
2SA 23:27 names Mebunnai the Hushathite, possibly the same man, but that is not certain, so the verse is left out.
The mention of him in the list of David's mighty men (1CH 11:29) and as captain of the eighth month's course (1CH 27:11) is an office or list entry, so it gets no clause.
